question.text: Let <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>A</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mn>3</mn></msub></math> be the three A.P. with the same common difference <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>d</mi></math> and having their first terms as <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>A</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>A</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mi>A</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn></math>, respectively. Let <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>a</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>b</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>c</mi></math> be the <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mn>7</mn><mtext>th </mtext></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mn>9</mn><mtext>th </mtext></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mn>17</mn><mtext>th </mtext></msup></math> terms of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>A</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mn>3</mn></msub></math>, respectively such that <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced open="|" close="|"><mtable columnalign="left"><mtr><mtd><mi>a</mi></mtd><mtd><mn>7</mn></mtd><mtd><mn>1</mn></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mn>2</mn><mi>b</mi></mtd><mtd><mn>17</mn></mtd><mtd><mn>1</mn></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mi>c</mi></mtd><mtd><mn>17</mn></mtd><mtd><mn>1</mn></mtd></mtr></mtable></mfenced><mo>+</mo><mn>70</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>. If <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>a</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>29</mn></math>, then the sum of first <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>20</mn></math> terms of an AP whose first term is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>c</mi><mo>-</mo><mi>a</mi><mo>-</mo><mi>b</mi></math> and common difference is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mi>d</mi><mn>12</mn></mfrac></math>, is equal to _____ .

solution.text:
From the definition of A.P., we have

a=A+6d   ....i

b=A+1+8d   ....ii

c=A+2+16d   ....iii

Now, we are given

a712b171c171+70=0

⇒A+6d712A+2+16d171A+2+16d171+70=0

⇒A+6d712+4d3-1-A00+70=0

⇒10A+70=0

⇒A=-7

So,

a=A+6d

⇒29=-7+6d

⇒d=6

∴c-a-b=1+2d-A=13+7=20

And, d12=612=12

So,

S20=20240+19×12=5×99=495
